title: Where Can I Buy Fertilizer for Palay Near Me? Finding a Fertilizer Store You Can Trust
metaTitle: Fertilizer Store Near Me: Where to Buy Palay Fertilizer
metaDescription: Looking for a fertilizer store near me? Check the FPA license, buy in bulk through your cooperative, order online safely and buy only the bags you need.
excerpt: The best fertilizer store near me is a dealer licensed by the Fertilizer and Pesticide Authority (FPA). It sells sealed, registered bags and gives an official receipt. Check the store on the FPA list, compare its price with the FPA weekly average, and pool big orders through your cooperative. As a farm app built for Filipino farmers, anee.io does not sell fertilizer, but it keeps your suppliers in one Contact List and counts the bags your plan needs.

blocks.text: A map search for a fertilizer store near me shows every shop in town. It does not tell you which ones hold a license, sell sealed bags or charge a fair price. Those three checks matter more than distance, because a fake bag costs you yield as well as money.

items: **Buy from an FPA licensed dealer** and ask for an official receipt.
**Check every bag:** sealed, with its grade and FPA registration number.
**Pool big orders** through your cooperative or irrigators association.
**Know your number of bags** before you go, so you buy only what the crop needs.

blocks.text: When you ask for complete fertilizer for palay, ask for the grade, 14 14 14, not a brand. Our guide to the [best fertilizer for palay](/blog/best-fertilizer-for-palay) shows which grade goes on at each stage.
How do I know a fertilizer dealer is licensed?

Every fertilizer company in the Philippines that makes, imports, distributes or sells fertilizer needs an FPA license first. The FPA posts its licensed handlers on its website, with each company's address, region, license type and expiry date. You can also ask the store to show you its license.

That list also answers which local companies produce fertilizer. It marks each company as a manufacturer, importer, national distributor, repacker or bulk blender, among others. Our guide to the [Fertilizer and Pesticide Authority](/blog/fertilizer-and-pesticide-authority) shows how to check both the store and the product.
Can I buy fertilizer in bulk or as a season package?

Yes, and a season plan makes it simple. The PhilRice Abonong Swak plan for 5 to 6 tons per hectare uses 2 bags of complete or 16 20 0 and 2 bags of urea. It adds half a bag of muriate of potash. At FPA national averages for October 5 to 9, 2026, that came to about PHP 9,114 per hectare, with complete as the basal. So buy the whole package before planting, and the top dressing bags will be in your shed on time.

For bulk urea or ammonium sulfate, a cooperative or irrigators association can collect its members' orders. Then it can ask its regular dealer, or a distributor on the FPA list, for a quote. Ask who pays for delivery, and get it on the receipt.
Is there a fertilizer subscription for palay farmers?

We could not verify any fertilizer subscription service for palay in the Philippines. A standing order with your dealer or cooperative does the same job. Set it by your season plan, so the right bags arrive before each dose.
How do I order palay fertilizer online safely?
The FPA says online sellers of fertilizers and pesticides must follow the 2022 Joint Administrative Order on online businesses. Whatever the platform, run these four checks before you pay.

items.title: Check the seller
items.text: Look for the company on the FPA list of licensed handlers. A shop page with no company name or address is a warning sign.

items.title: Check the product
items.text: Match the product name, grade and registration number with the FPA list of registered fertilizers. Make sure the registration has not expired.

items.title: Check the price
items.text: Compare the price, delivery included, with the FPA weekly average for your province. A price far below every store nearby deserves a hard look.

items.title: Check the delivery
items.text: Ask for an official receipt. On arrival, check that each fertilizer bag still has its seal, and weigh one of them.

blocks.text: Where to buy rice fertilizer in Metro Manila or elsewhere in Luzon

Metro Manila has few rice fields. The FPA survey for October 5 to 9, 2026 lists no fertilizer prices for NCR. But it does list nearby Bulacan, Cavite and Laguna, plus Nueva Ecija, Pampanga, Tarlac, Isabela and other Luzon provinces. For a supplier anywhere in Luzon, filter the FPA list of licensed handlers by region. Then call or visit the stores in your town.
Where can I find fertilizer discounts for palay?

The steadiest discount is the one you make yourself. Buy only the bags your soil needs, and compare the price per kilo of nutrient. Past DA programs have also given discount vouchers to rice farmers in the RSBSA, the national registry of farmers. Our [fertilizer subsidy](/blog/fertilizer-subsidy-philippines) guide explains who qualifies and why you should ask your MAO each season.

The FPA weekly list is your yardstick for the fertilizer price. If your fertilizer dealer quotes far above the average for your province, ask why, or compare with the next town. Our [fertilizer price guide](/blog/fertilizer-price-philippines) shows how to read the list.

blocks.title: Signs of a fake or short bag
blocks.text: Walk away from bags with torn or resewn seals or no FPA registration number. The same goes for a grade that does not match the FPA list, and for any seller who will not give a receipt. Report doubtful products to the FPA at focu@fpa.da.gov.ph or (02) 8927 3647.
Can a farm app order fertilizer from suppliers for me?

Not anee.io. It does not sell fertilizer, take orders or pay suppliers, and its Shop is not live yet. You still buy from your dealer or cooperative. What anee.io does is make sure you walk in knowing what to buy.

Keep every dealer and supplier in the [Contact List](/features/farm-contact-list), with notes and tags such as Urea or Delivers. Your protocol adds up what its fertilizer tasks will use. On Solo Farmer, the [farm inventory](/features/farm-inventory-and-expenses) sets that against the bags in your shed. So you see what is left to buy. The free [NPK Plus calculator](/features/npk-plus-calculator) also checks that those bags give your crop enough, and not too much.

blocks.text: Questions about finding a fertilizer store near me

items.q: Do I have to buy fertilizer from an FPA licensed store?
items.a: Under the law, the FPA must register a fertilizer before anyone sells it, and handlers need a license first. Buying from a licensed store, with a receipt, is the safest way to get the grade you paid for.

items.q: How many bags of fertilizer do I need for one hectare of palay?
items.a: The PhilRice plan for 5 to 6 tons uses four and a half bags per hectare. That is 2 bags of complete or 16 20 0, 2 of urea and half a bag of 0 0 60. Your soil test may call for more or less, as our guide to [bags of fertilizer per hectare](/blog/bags-of-fertilizer-per-hectare) explains.
Sometimes. Compare the price with delivery included against the FPA weekly average for your province. A cheap bag that turns out fake or underweight is the most expensive one.

items.q: Which fertilizer dealer near me sells complete fertilizer for palay?
items.a: We do not name or recommend stores. Ask your Municipal Agriculture Office and other farmers which licensed stores nearby carry 14 14 14. Then check each one on the FPA list of licensed handlers.
